results.description: REGISTRATION_REJECT; evidence must include the reject frame.

final_json.root_cause: UDR returned HTTP 404 when the AMF attempted to retrieve authentication subscription data for imsi-001010099999999. The UE is not provisioned in the 5G core database.

results.description: UPF unreachable; diagnosis must reach PFCP/UPF.

final_json.summary: UE registration succeeded but PDU session establishment failed because the UPF did not respond to PFCP Session Establishment Requests, causing the SMF to repeatedly retry creating the session.
final_json.failure_point: seq 438-439: PFCP SESSION_ESTABLISHMENT_REQUEST (SMF→UPF) - no success response
final_json.root_cause: UPF not responding to PFCP session establishment requests; SMF sends SESSION_ESTABLISHMENT_REQUEST but receives only ICMP echo (seq 439 shows pfcp msg wrapped in icmp), causing PDU session to remain pending. UE repeatedly sends PDU_SESSION_ESTABLISHMENT_REQUEST (seq 387,1149,1812,2545,3241,3936) but never receives ACCEPT.

evidence.note: UE→SMF: PDU session request (type 0xc1) - no ACCEPT follows
SMF→UPF: PFCP session request (msg_type=50) - no response
SMF→UPF: repeated PFCP request - still no response
AMF→UE: periodic DL NAS (no session data)
Final DL NAS transport - PDU session never established
